Looks the shopper up with customer-ordering GET /shoppers?email=. There is no password and no authentication; the cookie only remembers which shopper the page acts for. A POST, so it requires an Idempotency-Key; the lookup is a GET upstream, so no upstream key is forwarded and in practice the answer never carries Idempotency-Replayed and never answers 409 (both are declared only because the fleet REST guideline requires them on every keyed POST). Without a body of \{email\} (at most 254 characters, no other field) the answer is 422 validation-failed.
